scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @nr/web" "npm run dev -w @nr/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nr/shared && npm run build -w @nr/api && npm run build -w @nr/web && npm run build -w @nr/agent
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @nr/web && npm run lint -w @nr/api && npm run lint -w @nr/agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nr/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nr/api && npm run typecheck -w @nr/web && npm run typecheck -w @nr/agent
